image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a laminated restaurant menu. The menu features a green border and contains text in both English and Thai. Visible sections include a large photo of a black sticky rice dessert with toppings, labeled 'STICKY RICE' (with some garbled text above it), and smaller photos of other dishes at the top. A red plastic utensil handle is visible at the very top edge.

artifact_observations.location: Main title area below the dessert image
artifact_observations.reasoning: The large red text reads 'STICKY RICE' but is preceded by nonsensical, melted characters ('SCAKERSAR' or similar). This is a classic AI failure mode where the model approximates letter shapes without understanding orthography.

artifact_observations.location: Body text columns to the right of the dessert image
artifact_observations.reasoning: The lines of text mimic the appearance of a list but dissolve into unreadable scribbles and non-existent characters upon close inspection.
Slight blurring and 'smearing' of the background elements and the edge of the menu, lacking the sharp definition expected from a camera focus on a nearby object.
The red object at the top appears to merge slightly with the background/menu edge, lacking a clear physical boundary or shadow casting.
